_notes.name: The name in the greeting at the top of the page.
_notes.units: "kg" or "lb". Every number on the page reads in these units; the person can switch in Settings.
_notes.goal: The goal weight in those units. The chart draws it as a dashed line and marks the date the trend reaches it.
_notes.smoothing: Optional, 0.1 when left out. How far each weigh-in moves the trend line, from 0.01 (very calm) to 0.5 (quick to follow the scale).
_notes.showProjection: Optional, true when left out. false hides the goal date and its marker.
_notes.theme: "mist" (light), "slate" (dark), or "auto" (Mist or Slate, following the system).
_notes.sample: Optional. true fills a first visit with three months of made-up weigh-ins so the chart has something to show; leave it out for a real start.
